notes.title: Body Pay Series Bundle "French Fries" Released★
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44973741/e644e32c14609959f081e4953cdabc76ff42fdf5.png[/img]

Hello, Sir!
I'm Cheese Burger Studio's secretary Sato!

To celebrate the STEAM Spring Sale, Sato is back with a new menu item from Cheese Burger Studio, the "French Fries" Bundle!
Ta-da!!!

For more details, please check the link below~★

Due to the "Body Pay" ban, the bundle may not be visible to sir living in Korea, but we are looking into how to re-release it, so please support us!!!

[h1][b]https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/47686/_/[/b]
[/h1]

And here's something I'd like to show sir in secret: a screenshot of "I Will Purify You", which we got a lot of love for during the last STEAM Next Fest... Shhhhh...

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44973741/4b5ace070cf5051f469aea0e1d1dc88f8a102508.png[/img]

"I.P.U", scheduled to be released this year, is in the process of developing more fun balance and systems, so please show lots of love!!!

We'll come back with more good titles and news.
Sato's report is over!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2950350/_/

notes.title: Update Notice
notes.content:
Hello, Sir!
I'm Cheese Burger Studio's secretary Sato!

We're back with some bug fixes and added features that you've reported or that I, Sato, have found!
Details are summarized below, so please continue to show your love!!!

Please also show a lot of interest in the demo of "I Will Purify You!" that was released this time!!!~☆
 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3406670/__DEMO/
 
  
We'll come back with more good titles and news.
Sato's report is over!
 
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
[h2][b]※ Bug fix List[/b][/h2]
· Fixed the animation where the arm was unnaturally cut off in the Detective Stage 8 event scene.

· Fixed the issue where the STEAM Acheivement was not completed when clearing all puzzle modes.

· Fixed the issue where the text was broken in Traditional Chinese.

· Fixed the issue where the next scene was shown first during the event scene transition.

· Fixed the issue where the navigation UI on the left was not synchronized when using the Detective's skill on the puzzle screen.

[h2][b]※ Add features[/b][/h2]
· For those who participated in the beta test or Curator Connect and the game does not work properly in the official release, we have added a save data reset function.

· The save data reset function is located in the upper left of the settings window, and using this function will reset stage clear information, album unlock information, and character nickname information.
